newsitem.title: USA: Liz Taylor fears new seizure, publicist says.
newsitem.headline: Liz Taylor fears new seizure, publicist says.

text.p: Actress Elizabeth Taylor, who suffered a seizure that put her back in a hospital three days after brain surgery, wants to stay there longer for fear it might happen again, her publicist said on Wednesday.

"She's doing fine but she wants to stay (longer), she feels more secure there," Shirene Coburn said. "She's afraid it will recur," she said of the mild seizure Taylor suffered on Saturday, three days after being released from the hospital.

The Oscar-winning screen star was re-admitted that day to Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre, where she had undergone four hours of surgery on Feb. 20 to remove an apparently benign tumour the size of a golf ball from the lining of her brain.
Taylor, who celebrated her 65th birthday on Thursday, is still undergoing tests, Coburn said, and it is up to doctors to decide when she can go home.
"I don't expect it today, but soon," said the publicist, who stressed such seizures are a common side effect of brain surgery.
